title: Meet a power from both directions
hook: Meet a power from both directions. Follow the computed steps.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Integer remainders, gcd, primes, modular exponentiation.
doesNotKnow: Solve a discrete logarithm by matching baby powers against inverse giant steps.

misconception: A modular exponent must be inverted by trying every exponent sequentially.
objective: Solve a discrete logarithm by matching baby powers against inverse giant steps.

claims.text: Baby powers store the short exponent offsets. Inverse giant steps remove blocks from the target; a collision combines a block count and offset, then modular exponentiation checks the resulting exponent.
